purpose: Curated failure cases, regression anomalies, and physical limit breaches used to calibrate readiness penalties, surface exact math/physics root causes, and educate beginners and aerospace designers.

failure_cases.root_cause: Aged cell internal resistance R0 + polarization V_rc drives constant-power quadratic discriminant negative (P > V_th^2 / 4R) before nominal cutoff.
failure_cases.threshold: V_bus < V_cutoff (3.20 V/cell) or voltage collapse

failure_cases.root_cause: Bus voltage sag below 14 V study line saturates thrust below hover weight, inducing uncontrolled descent in closed loop.
1P rotor imbalance / single-branch ESC power asymmetry compensated by autopilot RPM (+13-20%) masks steady hover fault until saturation.
failure_cases.physics_law: I_branch^2 * R_m thermal runaway / 1P vibration energy
failure_cases.threshold: Motor temp > 95 C or branch cutoff

failure_cases.root_cause: Excessive arm moment or undersized ISO 4762 M2/M3 fasteners under heavy payload climb exceeds bending yield or bolt shear capacity.
failure_cases.physics_law: sigma_max = M*c/I, V_bolt > tau_allow * A_s, P_cr = pi^2 E I / L^2

failure_cases.root_cause: Bluff-body cargo box drag (Cd ~ 1.4) + off-CG tether attachment excites cable pendulum frequency omega = sqrt(g/L) and pitch-back saturation.
failure_cases.physics_law: omega_pend = sqrt(g/L), tau_cg = r_tether x F_cable, F_D = 0.5*rho*V^2*Cd*A
failure_cases.threshold: Trail angle > 35 deg or residual control authority < 15%

failure_cases.root_cause: Overspeed past Korn M_DD steepens wave drag Cd_w = 20*(M - M_cr)^4 while choked intake / poor cooling raises turbine EGT > 720-730 C.
failure_cases.physics_law: MIL-E-5008B eta_r, choked m_dot_max, EGT thermal cap
failure_cases.threshold: EGT > max_temp or M > M_max or T_net < D_total

failure_cases.root_cause: Transitioning horizontally too slowly or with insufficient propwash slipstream over elevons causes deep pitch-up stall.
failure_cases.threshold: Pitch moment margin < 1.1x or |alpha| > 14 deg without stall protection

failure_cases.root_cause: High water chop + heavy float loading traps aircraft behind displacement hump speed Fn_L = 0.45 where R_hump >= Thrust.
failure_cases.physics_law: Savitsky 1964 planing lift + NACA hump drag R_hump

failure_cases.root_cause: Excessive flap frequency / stroke pushes M_tip > 0.25 or cyclic bending stress past hinge fatigue limit S_e.
Supercooled LWC ice accretion erodes leading-edge suction peak, collapsing CL_max and tripling parasitic profile drag.
failure_cases.threshold: Ice thickness / CL loss exceeds stall margin
